user.title: Hegel Connect
user.description: Unofficial integration for Hegel H150, H400 and H600 streaming amplifiers. Enter the IP address of the amplifier (give it a fixed address in your router).

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the amplifier, e.g. 192.168.1.50

discovery_confirm.title: Hegel Connect
discovery_confirm.description:
Found **{name}** at {host}. Add it to Home Assistant?

Tip: give the amplifier a fixed address in your router; if the address changes, Home Assistant picks up the new one automatically when it sees the amplifier again.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the amplifier on this address. Is it on the network (also works in standby)?
error.not_supported: A device answered, but it does not look like a Hegel H150, H400 or H600.

abort.not_supported: This device does not look like a Hegel H150, H400 or H600.
abort.already_in_progress: This amplifier is already being set up.
